summary: Reference host for Open PON testing. RouterOS supports 2.5G SFP link rates from v7.11.

recommended.note: most-used host. The 10G SFP+ cage accepts both GPON and XGS-PON sticks.

features: 2.5G SFP link rate since RouterOS v7.11
SFP cage compatibility across RouterBOARD and CCR platforms
Optical DDM readings in RouterOS without vendor tools
Listed firmware is regression tested on RouterOS first

notes: MediaTek Filogic 880 board with two SFP+ cages, running OpenWrt. Host for the MediaTek track: OpenWrt on the router and open firmware on the PON stick.

Recommended model: Hero KN-1013, sold as Netcraze Giga NC-1013 in Russia and the EAEU. 10G SFP+ cage and five 2.5G ports. The cage runs at 2.5 Gbps when used as WAN. Keenetic's compatibility list includes 2.5G GPON sticks. Older Giga and Ultra models also have an SFP cage. Verified and supplied in Turkey by KYTECHNGAMING.
Works in SFP-equipped switches and routers. Behaviour varies by model and firmware revision.
Works in EdgeRouter and UniFi SFP ports. Verify link negotiation per model before deployment.
